class.description:
Decentralized interaction-aware MPPI critic implementing velocity prediction and multi-agent collision avoidance based on Trevisan et al. ICRA 2023.
Features: - Dynamic obstacle detection from TF tree - Constant velocity prediction for obstacles - COLREGs-like navigation rules (right-of-way, head-on avoidance) - Multi-agent collision cost evaluation

MPPI Critic for multi-robot collision avoidance using published optimal trajectories.
This critic subscribes to optimal trajectories published by other robots (via nav2_msgs::msg::Trajectory) and penalizes MPPI trajectory samples that would collide with those trajectories.
Features: - Decentralized multi-robot coordination with communication - COLREGs-like navigation rules (starboard, head-on detection) - Configurable collision margins and safety distances - Automatic robot discovery via topic subscriptions - Thread-safe trajectory access with mutex protection
Parameters: collision_cost (float): Hard collision penalty cost [default: 1000000.0] collision_margin (float): Minimum safety distance around obstacles in meters [default: 0.15] cost_weight (float): Weight of this critic relative to others [default: 1.5] max_trajectory_age (float): Maximum age of trajectory before discarding in seconds [default: 2.0] use_full_trajectory (bool): Whether to check full trajectory vs just endpoint [default: true] max_distance_to_consider (float): Maximum distance to consider robots for collision in meters [default: 5.0] lookahead_distance (float): How far ahead in trajectory to check in meters [default: 2.0] trajectory_interpolation_step (float): Interpolation step size for trajectory checking [default: 0.1] default_robot_radius (float): Default radius for remote robots in meters [default: 0.25] consider_footprint (bool): Whether to use full robot footprint vs point [default: true] local_robot_id (string): Robot ID to avoid self-checking [default: "ego"] trajectory_topic_patterns (vector): Topic patterns to search for trajectories [default: ["/robot_*/controller_server/optimal_trajectory"]] goal_topic_patterns (vector): Topic patterns to search for goal topics [default: ["/robot_*/controller_server/goal"]] regulation_violation_cost (float): COLREGs regulation violation penalty [default: 500.0] starboard_detection_radius (float): Detection radius for starboard right-of-way in meters [default: 1.0] starboard_detection_angle (float): Angular margin for starboard detection in radians [default: 0.349 (20 degrees)] head_on_angle_margin (float): Angular margin for head-on detection in radians [default: 0.349 (20 degrees)] relative_velocity_tolerance (float): Relative velocity threshold for dynamic detection [default: 0.1] min_velocity_threshold (float): Minimum velocity to consider robot moving [default: 0.1] publish_debug_markers (bool): Enable RViz debug marker publishing [default: false]
